title: Gewürzregal
author: DieselKisters
description:
Spice rack for rectangular and round spice jars for the kitchen. Individual compartments accommodate jars with a cross-sectional area of 40x40mm; there are 16 compartments in total. Simple, stable, and straightforward.

The screw holes are currently designed for M3x10 screws. If you wish to melt in threaded inserts, you will need to enlarge the holes of each level to prevent filament from entering the threads. Sixteen screws are needed for assembly; they hold very well even without inserts.
